newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria M1 rises 16 pct, M2 down 8 pct Feb 14-21.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria M1 rises 16 pct, M2 down 8 pct Feb 14-21.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 382.1 billion levs ($244.2 million) on February 21 from 329.8 billion levs on February 14, and M2 fell to 3,945.7 billion levs from 4,287.3 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money decreased 7.96 percent to 4,273.9 billion levs in the week to February 21 as lev-denominated broad money rose 10.90 percent to 835.1 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money fell 11.61 percent to 3,438.8 billion levs.
Companies' hard currency-denominated deposits totalled $747.1 million on February 21, up from $745.4 million a week earlier.
But individuals' foreign currency-denominated deposits fell by $0.8 million to $459.6 million in the week to February 21, figures showed.

Individuals' lev-denominated deposits edged up to 75.6 billion levs on February 21 from 74.6 billion levs a week earlier. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569 ($ = 1565 Bulgarian Levs)
